notes.title: V0.3.1 Update log
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone!
The Spring Festival is approaching, and I would like to extend my greetings to all of you in advance. Wishing you a happy Lunar New Year! [/h3]
It has been six months since the EA version was launched. During the past six months, we have maintained a regular weekly update frequency and released over 40 game updates of various sizes; Based on the opinions and suggestions of a large number of players, the game content has been comprehensively expanded and optimized.
This is our promise when launched, and we will strive to fulfill it and not disappoint the expectations.(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و
In the new year, we will continue to make various supplements and optimizations to the game, improve operational convenience, and bring players more and more fun game content~

Speaking back to now, the following is the updated game content:
[h3] [New Content] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the storyline and task flow for the second week of the game. Once the main storyline of the fairy world is completed, the game can begin.
[*] Added drop and forging functions for magical equipment (second week content).
[*] Added the synthesis function of the alchemy room, which can be activated after level 4 of the alchemy room to synthesize low-level materials into high-level materials.
[*] Added some formulas for synthesis.
[*] Added or replaced some art resources.
[/list]
[h3] [Optimization and Adjustment] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Significantly reduced the value of mana replenishment during enemy ghost evasion.
[*] The automatically claimed sect resources will no longer frequently pop up bubble prompts.
[*] Zongmen Architecture - The house will now automatically record the previous sorting information.
[/list]
[h3] [Problem fix] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where some plot dialogues sometimes froze and could only be skipped.
[*] Fixed the issue where the task reward for the side quest "catching medicine" was not correctly obtained.
[*] Fixed the issue of incorrect output in the resource building prompts for clicking on "Mine" and "Quarry".
[*] Fixed the issue of logical errors in bulk sales of Zongmen Architecture - Houses.
[*] Fixed the issue where the equipment skill "X Spirit Blessing · Si" displayed a level higher than the actual value.
[*] Fixed the issue of errors in the "Spirit Mine" materials produced by the special area Boss in each chapter.
[*] Fixed some text description errors.
[/list]

At the same time, our previous work 'Idle Devils' will also be updated later. Interested players can pay more attention to it~
Thank you all for your support and love all along. See you next year~(´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)

notes.title: V0.2.6 Update log
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone, regarding the issue of poor experience with some content in recent versions, we have received many opinions and feedback. First of all, we sincerely apologize to all players, Orz.[/h2]
[h3] These issues mainly include: some disgusting mechanisms causing the game to go to jail, difficulty in fighting monsters leading to insufficient enjoyment, various bugs causing poor gaming experience, etc.
We have focused on optimizing and fixing these issues this week, and will continue to follow up and improve the game based on feedback from players. [/h3]
[h3] [New Content] [/h3]
[list]
[*] A new swordsman's red technique has been added, which can be dropped in areas above the Divine Realm in Chapter 3.
[*] Added a red spell for the Stone Clan girl, which can be dropped in areas above the Divine Realm in Chapter 5.
[*] A reputation side quest for Cloud Sect has been added, and the divine skills rewarded in the quest can effectively help characters resist indirect and damage damage damage.
[*] Added or replaced some art resources (feature icons, technique icons, etc.).
[*] Added scrollbars on various backpack interfaces.
[/list]
[h3] [Optimization and Adjustment] [/h3]
[list]
[*] significantly reduced the number of poisoned layers applied by the enemy - the snake - upon death.
[*] Greatly reduced the value of the enemy chisel tooth's' damage reflection 'attribute.
[*] Reduced the mana acquisition attribute value of enemies in the entire realm.
[*] The character's spiritual root attribute bonus is increased by 1% for every 1 spiritual root, corresponding to attribute damage bonus.
[*] The level features of the retrograde realm have been reduced in value, and the effect has been changed to healing, which can be affected by healing bonuses (including the [Heavy Damage] debuff).
[*] The value of the level feature in the Disabled Heart Realm has been reduced, and the damage dealt has been changed to be based on the amount of health lost.
[/list]
[h3] [Problem fix] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects of some high-level road skills were not effective or were incorrectly activated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the protagonist may not be able to select another protagonist after equipping multiple copies of "Reactive Power · X Form" at the same time.
[*] Fixed the issue of premature upgrade of branch tasks in Zongmenfang City and Zangjingge.
[*] Fixed the issue where the reply effect could also trigger the 'Hundred Flowers Xuandian'.
[*] Fixed an issue where the battle would not end even if all player characters were killed in special circumstances.
[*] Fixed the issue where BD achieving unlimited ultimate moves would cause battle freezes.
[*] Fixed an issue where some skill effects could still be triggered after a character's death.
[*] Fixed some text description errors.
[/list]
[h3] Finally, we apologize once again for the bad gaming experience we have brought to all players. [/h3]

notes.title: V0.1.26 Update log
notes.notes:
[h3] [New Content] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added or improved brand new skill groups for all monsters.
[*] Added a level selection interface where you can view monster introductions and skill information through Tips.
[/list]
[h3] [Optimization and Adjustment] [/h3]
[list]
[*] The overall performance significantly reduces the number of waves in a single level.
[*] has increased the value of basic attributes for later monsters (monsters below the spirit realm are almost unaffected).
[*] significantly increased the playback speed of the main battle cutscenes.
The suppression effect of the Heavenly Dao no longer suppresses the probability of a lucky strike.
[*] The passive skill of Snow Clan Girls - Wind and Snow Strike will now have a total lucky strike probability reduced by 60% to 30% (depending on level).
[*] Rain Master's passive skill - Ze Shou Wan Wu won't advance the action bar during a lucky strike, but has added the effect of a probability of obtaining shield value when damaged.
[*] Negative state - The damage multiplier of each layer of poisoning has been increased from 2% of attack power to 4%.
[*] The life absorption effect is adjusted to restore no more than 10% of one's maximum life each time it is triggered.
When conducting directional melting, the current affix washing record information will now be reset.
[*] Adjust the timing of cutting and erasing the double-edged sword to attack or cause damage before triggering, in order to maximize its benefits.
[/list]
[h3] [Problem fix] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where if there are multiple identical entries during affix training, they will be fixed with the first one.
[*] When repairing and purifying negative states such as damage, the actual effect does not match expectations.
[*] Fixed the issue where damage caused by a deceased source would be lost.
[/list]
Due to the upcoming update of the follow-up content and new DLC for our previous game 'Hanging Queen Demon' this month, the development speed of Xiantu has been affected to some extent. However, we can guarantee that we will complete the production of the plot and levels for the upcoming Ascension Realm and Immortal Realm during the National Day holiday (we will release them as early as possible). Thank you for your understanding and support~(´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)

notes.title: Version 0.1.2 Update
notes.notes:
7/26/2024 - Version 0.1.2 Update

[New Features]
·Increased the breakthrough limit of character realms to include Ling Realm.
·Added a damage statistics interface during battles.

[Bug Fixes]
·Fixed issues with certain Boss equipment skills causing battles to freeze.
·Corrected the incorrect selling prices of equipment above Foundation Establishment realm.
·Addressed issues where some character spirit root attributes were not functioning properly.
·Resolved the problem where the inventory count in the grocery section of the market always showed as 1.
·Fixed instances where goods in the market would unexpectedly display prompt messages.
·Corrected the display issue with the auto-sell checkbox on the battle settlement interface.
·Fixed the delay in refreshing the Hall of Heroes upon acquiring new character tokens.
·Fixed anomalies in the trigger probabilities of equipment skills like the Feiniu.

Due to significant differences between the demo version and the current EA version, we have temporarily closed the demo version for play. We plan to optimize and reopen the demo version soon. Additionally, please note: Players who have already played the official version should avoid launching the demo version to prevent potential loss of official version save data. We are working to resolve this issue promptly.

notes.title: February 7th Update & Issue Fixes
notes.notes:
February 7th Update & Issue Fixes

We're back with another round of updates and issue fixes based on player feedback collected today. After a day of hard work, here's what we've updated and fixed:

【New Features】

Added descriptions of Buff effects in skill tips.
Temporarily added a feature to remove characters from the lineup. Characters can be removed by placing them back in the same position in the lineup.
【Bug Fixes】

Fixed drop rates for blueprints.
Resolved issues with accessing map information screens in certain situations.
Fixed a bug where the backpack wouldn't refresh after quick-selling equipment.
Corrected equipment name display errors.
Fixed an issue where the Hall of Heroes wouldn't refresh characters of blue or higher rarity.
Resolved a bug where skills labeled as "locked" for characters still functioned in combat.
Fixed display errors for swordsman skill groups.
Fixed issues where some quests or dialogue sequences wouldn't trigger properly.
Corrected visual effects errors and issues with unsuccessful creations.
Fixed incorrect information prompts for "Lord's Battle."
We'll continue to update and optimize the game during the New Release Festival, looking forward to refining the journey with you and making it even more exciting! Thank you for your continued support!

Join our QQ group to transcend tribulations together! (Group ID: 537185437)

notes.title: 2024/2/6 Update & Issue Fixes
Trial version is here~
notes.notes:
It’s finally time for the demo version to be released~ In the demo version, you can experience the first 60 levels of the game in the first chapter of the current development progress. It also opens up gameplay such as the Casting Workshop and the Hall of Heroes to build your path to immortality. The team and 6 completely different styles of characters that can be played will also give everyone a preliminary understanding of the Xiantuhuangze Continent.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799917/58e9c28d1ca02f7634ffc0e0e495710ffbc4789a.jpg[/img]


However, we also sincerely admit that the game has many shortcomings, so we urgently need your valuable opinions and suggestions. Your feedback is important to us and will help improve the game and make it even better. We look forward to working with you to polish the fairy road and make it even more exciting! Thank you all for your continued support!
